cues.text: The first page was small: a room, a handwritten plan and one deadline.
The people arrived before the system, and photographs became memory.
Every place added another piece to the journey.
Documents and citations kept the emotional story anchored to evidence.
Then the library became a visual language.
We stopped rebuilding and started telling.
What survived was the evidence, the people and the reason the work mattered.
Every archive is waiting for motion.
